messages:
Priya (Data): Heads up — Monday pulse for the demo series. Numbers look weird: sessions -> demo signups +8% MoM but qualified leads down 22%. Dashboard: https://pulse.redwood.ai/dashboards/demo-series

Ben (Ops): I saw that too. Think it's routing: lots of signups are going to growth-sdr instead of product-trials. Pinged infra earlier.

Liam (Creative): Did we change the CTA copy in the launch post? We moved from 'Book demo' to 'See it in action' last week.

Aisha (Growth): Yep — that was the Q4 copy test. Early signal was higher click rate but lower intent. Should we revert?

Priya (Data): Putting quick cohort SQL — can someone run this against prod? 
```sql
SELECT utm_source, landing_variation, count(*) as signups, sum(is_qualified) as quals
FROM demo_signups
WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY utm_source, landing_variation
ORDER BY signups DESC
``` 

Marketing-Bot: New dashboard snapshot uploaded: https://pulse.redwood.ai/snapshots/2045-demo-snapshot

Ben (Ops): Re routing — found misconfigured rule in the inbound flow: `if source == 'webinar' and utm_campaign contains 'launch'` was missing the 'launch-2026' slug. Fixing now.

Priya (Data): After fix run that SQL again, but also let's add `landing_variation` dimension to see creative impact.

Liam (Creative): Can we A/B subject lines + CTA toggles for next send? Idea: 'See Redwood in action' vs 'Join a live demo — spaces limited'

Aisha (Growth): Let's do it. Target: 4k sends, track CTR, demo conversion, and SDR accept rate. Thresholds: CTR uplift >=6% and conversion >=10% to keep variant.

Ben (Ops): I've queued the routing patch to staging. Deploying at 10:30 PT. @everyone please pause manual tag edits until 11:00 PT :pray: 

Priya (Data): Agreed. I'll update dashboard tiles to show landing_variation + routing status. Also adding quick anomaly alert: `demo_conversion < historical_p50 * 0.9` -> slack alert.

Liam (Creative): I'll draft two CTAs and subject lines by EOD. Sending to @Aisha for final sign-off.

Aisha (Growth): Sweet. Quick ask: can Product Ops drop the list of 'trial invites' to growth-sdr so we can check handoff quality?

Ben (Ops): Yep I'll export and attach to the thread when done.

Priya (Data): Next check-in Wed 9am PT. If routing fix improves quals by >15% we'll do a filtered retarget. Otherwise revert copy.

Liam (Creative): :thumbsup: 

Marketing-Bot: Reminder — weekly KPI review Wed 9:00 in #marketing. Agenda updated: https://calendar.redwood.ai/meet/marketing-weekly

Aisha (Growth): Thanks — wrapping this thread. Anyone else see different signals, DM me.
